SpreadsheetMaps.ErrorMessage:
Spreadsheet must contain the Quarterly Returns tab.
The Quarterly Returns tab is missing from your file or has been renamed.
Action required: Open your spreadsheet and make sure the Quarterly Returns tab is present. It must follow the naming format exactly with no spelling mistakes or additional spaces.

DataColumns.ErrorMessage:
Column A in the the Quarterly returns tab must be empty.
There is at least one letter or number in at least one box in column A.
Action required: Clear all data from column A, save the file then submit it again.

Column B in the the Quarterly returns tab cannot be empty.
There is no data in any of the boxes in column B.
Action required: Make sure the row names in the file match those that are in the template, save the file then submit it again.

SpreadsheetMaps.ErrorMessage:
Spreadsheet must contain the Cover tab.
The Cover tab is missing from your file or has been renamed.
Action required: Open your spreadsheet and make sure the Cover tab is present. It must follow the naming format exactly with no spelling mistakes or additional spaces.

Rules.ErrorMessage: Date range in cell B5 in the Quarterly returns tab can only cover one year. The date range in the cell is too long or short. Action required: Edit the spreadsheet so the date in the cell follows the required format, like 2025-26 or 2026-27.

Local authority names must match. The names you have given for the local authority you are submitting data for do not match. Action required: Check and correct the local authority you have selected in this service and named in cell B13 in the Cover page of the spreadsheet.
